description: Scripts this skill is permitted to run, with their arguments. Mirrors the argparse contract in universal_to_pptx.py exactly.

scripts.name: universal_to_pptx
scripts.description: Convert one or more input files (pptx, xlsx, xlsm, csv, tsv, pdf, html, htm, md, markdown, txt, png, jpg, jpeg, webp, gif, bmp, bpmn) into a single editable, brand-templated .pptx with native charts and tables.

arguments.name: --template
arguments.description: Brand template .pptx whose masters, layouts, theme and fonts are inherited

arguments.name: --brand
arguments.description: Brand pack .json (colors, fonts, sizes, spacing, footer text)

arguments.name: --max-rows
arguments.description: Rows per table slide before paginating

arguments.name: --no-charts
arguments.description: Render spreadsheet data as tables only; skip native charts

arguments.name: --no-ocr
arguments.description: Skip OCR of scanned pages and images
